usage: deskops review record [-h] --kind
                             {reproduction,goldens,owner,preflight,bundle}
                             [--evidence EVIDENCE] --reason REASON
                             [--operator OPERATOR] [--root ROOT]
                             [--format {text,json,yaml}]
                             task

Record a reproduction, goldens, owner, preflight, or bundle receipt from operator evidence (no model call).

positional arguments:
  task                  Task selector.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --kind {reproduction,goldens,owner,preflight,bundle}
                        Receipt kind; node comes from its own review command.
                        A recorded preflight or bundle is a human receipt
                        (engine human), not a model review.
  --evidence EVIDENCE   Existing file inside the root (repeatable); required
                        for every kind but owner.
  --reason REASON       What the operator checked; recorded in the ReviewDoc.
  --operator OPERATOR   Name of the human who reviewed; required for preflight
                        and bundle, recorded as the receipt's actor.
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --format {text,json,yaml}
                        Output format.

Example:
  deskops review record task-fix-thing --kind reproduction --evidence runs/repro.log --reason "..." --root .
  deskops review record task-fix-thing --kind owner --reason "approved by the owner" --root .
  deskops review record task-fix-thing --kind preflight --operator "Ana" --evidence desk/tasks/task-fix-thing.md --reason "read the contract; no ambiguity" --root .

The receipt is a ReviewDoc with verdict pending, engine human, and input_sha256 over the sorted
evidence files; `deskops review dispose <review-id>` writes its verdict. A preflight or bundle
recorded by hand requires --operator and says "no model available": it is for desks without a
model (CI scenarios, the quickstart), never a stand-in for `deskops review preflight|bundle`.
